content: Donna, you really shocked everyone at the party last night!
Yes! We have all assumed that you were the quiet, shy type.
I guess everyone has a few secrets up their sleeve.
Where did you learn to sing like that?
I was part of a band in school.
You? Wow. And why don't you ever dress like that at work?
Come on! This is work. Don't you think that would be a little weird?
